title: Removes the `tax_percent` attribute
summary: Removes tax_percent from objects and requests in favor of tax rates.

migrationNotes.text: Lets you manage taxation more flexibly by using the dedicated Tax Rates API instead of the previously available tax_percent property.

sources.quote: | [Removes the `tax_percent` attribute](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2020-08-27/removes-tax-percent-attribute.md) | Checkout, Billing, Invoicing | Breaking | api |
Removes `tax_percent` from objects and requests in favor of [tax rates](https://docs.stripe.com/api/tax_rates.md?api-version=2024-06-20).
